blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LLM agents with similar success rates can follow different action sequences. An Agent Behavior Map represents LLM-harness combinations using centered action log-likelihoods on shared reference trajectories, without requiring new environment rollouts from the target agent. We derive error bounds relating squared coordinate distances to trajectory KL under explicit assumptions, and across eight cross-scored models the distances track the directly measured trajectory KL in rank order. Across 100 LLMs and four environments, ALFWorld-based coordinates support performance prediction and identify behavioral similarities. In ALFWorld, these similarities persist after controlling for success rates and model size, including across model families. As an extension, harness-component displacements approximately compose, with accuracy varying across components and environments.
blocks.zh: 成功率相近的LLM剂可以遵循不同的动作序列. 一个代理行为映射(Agent Behavior Map)代表LLM-harness组合,在共享的参考轨迹上使用中心动作日志相类似,而不需要目标代理展开新的环境. 根据明确的假设,我们得出了与KL轨迹有关的平方坐标距离的误差界限,在八个交叉计分模型中,距离按照排名顺序跟踪直接测量的KL轨迹。 在100个LLMs和四个环境中,以ALFWorld为基础的协调支持性能预测并识别行为相似性. 在ALFWorld中,这些相似性在控制成功率和模型规模后继续存在,包括跨模型家庭. 作为一种延伸,利用成分迁移大约是构成的,准确性因组成部分和环境而异。

blocks.en: Comparing LLM agents is a matter not only of how often they succeed but also of how they act. Agents with similar success rates can differ in the tools they choose, the order of their actions, and how often they repeat an operation. Such behavior depends on the combination of the underlying LLM and the harness that manages history, planning, and reasoning ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ; Vats and Golev, 2026 ; Fan et al., 2026 ) . Running every combination in the environment reveals both performance and behavior, but each new agent to compare requires collecting new trajectories. This paper asks whether a representation that captures similarity of run-time behavior can be built without new environment runs of the target agent.
blocks.zh: 比较LLM代理人不仅是他们成功的次数,也是他们如何行动的问题。 成功率相近的代理人在他们选择的工具,行动顺序,以及重复一次操作的频率等方面可能有所不同. 这种行为取决于基础LLM与管理历史,规划和推理的取向(张等,2026;姚等,2026;瓦茨和高廖夫,2026;范等,2026. 运行环境中的每一个组合都揭示了性能和行为,但每个新的代理来比较需要收集出新的轨迹. 本文询问,在没有目标代理的新环境运行的情况下,是否能够构建一种能捕捉运行时行为相似性的表现.

blocks.en: When agents are compared by their log-likelihoods on shared reference trajectories, the difficulty is that the distribution of the histories on which the likelihoods are conditioned itself depends on the agent’s policy. The histories contained in the reference trajectories need not coincide with those that an agent reaches through its own actions. Whether similarity of action probabilities measured on shared histories corresponds to similarity of trajectory distributions and behavior at run time is therefore not obvious. How much of these on-policy properties can be captured by off-policy observations on fixed reference trajectories is the central question of this work.
blocks.zh: 当代理商在共享参考轨迹上的日志相似性进行对比时,困难在于其可能性取决于代理商的政策。 参考轨迹中包含的历史不一定与代理人通过其自身行动获得的历史相吻合。 因此,在共享历史中测量的动作概率的相似性是否与运行时间的轨迹分布和行为相似并不明显. 关于固定参考轨迹的政策外观察可以捕捉到多少这些政策性属性是这项工作的中心问题.

blocks.en: Language model maps, which vectorize log-likelihoods on shared texts, represent the relations between models in a common coordinate space ( Oyama et al., 2025 ) . Their extension to prompt–response distributions has examined performance prediction from conditional log-likelihoods and the approximate additivity of the coordinate displacements caused by prompt changes ( Oyama et al., 2026 ) . This paper applies the framework to agents that interact sequentially with an environment and answers the question above with theory and experiments.
blocks.zh: 语言模型图能将共享文本上的日志相向化,代表了模型在共同坐标空间中的关系(Oyama等,2025.). 它们的延伸至即时反应分布,从条件对数的相似性以及由即时变化造成的坐标位移的近似相加性(Oyama等,2026年)。 本文将框架应用于与环境相继相互作用的物剂,并以理论和实验来回答上述问题.

blocks.en: An Agent Behavior Map treats each agent as a pair of an LLM and a harness. Each agent rebuilds its input with its own harness from the shared external history in the reference trajectories, namely the task, the observations, and the past actions. The recorded actions are teacher-forced under this input, and the resulting log-likelihood vector is centered to give the agent’s coordinates. Because the reference trajectories are reused, the coordinates of a new agent can be computed without collecting any additional environment trajectories from it. Figure 1 shows an example in which agents that are close in these coordinates take similar action sequences when run. We validate the representation from two angles. • Theoretical and empirical relation to the trajectory distribution (§ 2 , § 3.1 ). Under assumptions on the locality of the two policies and on the mismatch with the reference distribution, we derive error bounds that relate squared coordinate distances to the KL divergence between trajectory distributions. The error decomposes into local approximation, reference mismatch, centering, and finite samples, and the decomposition shows how the step-level and trajectory-level representations differ in their dependence on trajectory length. In a cross-scoring experiment with eight models, we compare the coordinate distances with the directly measured trajectory KL, the target itself, and find a high rank correlation. • Validation on performance and behavior (§ 3.2 , § 3.3 ). We apply a common harness to 100 LLMs and evaluate coordinates built from ALFWorld reference trajectories alone on ALFWorld, TextWorld, BFCL, and MiniWoB++. Besides predicting the success rates of unevaluated models from the evaluation results of the others, we ask whether neighbors on the map generate similar action sequences. In ALFWorld in particular, the similarity of action sequences remains when compared with neighbors chosen by success rate or by size, and when the candidates are restricted to models of other families. These results support the view that the coordinates carry behavioral information that neither performance level nor model family explains. The accuracy of performance prediction and the strength of behavioral similarity among neighbors, however, depend on the environment and the measure. Finally, we represent the addition of a harness component as a displacement on the map and ask whether such displacements add up within an LLM (§ 4 ). Comparison with measured coordinates shows approximate additivity, with an accuracy that depends on the component and the environment.
blocks.zh: 代理行为 地图将每名特工视为一对LLM和一副吊带. 每个代理人利用自己在参考轨迹中共享的外部历史,即任务、观察和过去的行动,重建自己的投入。 所记录的动作都是由老师在这种输入下强制的,由此产生的类似日志的向量被以给剂的坐标为中心. 由于参考轨迹被再用,因此可以计算出新剂的坐标,而无需从中收集任何额外的环境轨迹. 图1显示一个实例,在这些坐标中接近的物剂在运行时采取类似的动作序列. 我们从两个角度验证这一表述。 • 与轨迹分布有关的理论和经验关系(第2节,第3.1节)。 根据关于两种政策的位置和与参考分布不匹配的假设,我们得出了与轨迹分布之间的KL相差相连接的平方坐标距离的错误界限。 误差分解为局部近似,参考不匹配,中和和有限度的样本,分解显示步位和轨迹水平的表示在对轨迹长度的依赖性上有何不同. 在与8个模型的交叉评分实验中,我们比较了坐标距离与直接被测量的轨迹KL,目标本身,并发现高阶相关. • 业绩和行为鉴定(第3.2节,第3.3节)。 我们在100个LLMs上应用了共同的用法,并评价仅由ALFWorld、TextWorld、BFCL和MiniWoB++上的ALFWorld参考轨迹所构建的坐标。 除了从其他模型的评价结果中预测未评价模型的成功率外,我们询问地图上的邻居是否产生类似的动作序列. 特别是在ALFWorld,与成功率或规模所选择的邻居相比,当候选人仅限于其他家庭的模式时,动作序列的相似性依然存在. 这些结果支持了这样的观点,即坐标携带的行为信息既没有性能水平,也没有模型家族解释. 然而,性能预测的准确性以及邻居之间行为相似性的强度取决于环境和度量. 最后,我们表示在地图上增加了作为流离失所的带子部分,并询问这种流离失所是否在LLM(§ 4)中有所增加。 与所测量坐标的比较显示大致相加性,准确性取决于组件和环境.

blocks.en: This section fixes the harness to a standard configuration (BASE: a history window of the last four steps, no planning, direct action; § 4.1 ) and places each LLM as one point. The question is what the coordinates capture about an agent. LM maps showed a correlation between coordinates and downstream performance ( Oyama et al., 2025 ) . We answer with three quantities: the target itself, the KL between the trajectory distributions of the agents when run (§ 3.1 ); one projection of it, the success rate (§ 3.2 ); and the behavior itself when run (§ 3.3 ).

blocks.en: From here on we use 100 open-weight LLMs. The reference trajectories are 500 trajectories with 10,388 steps, generated by two models (Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) and Gemma4-E4B ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) ) on 250 ALFWorld train tasks; every model scores them, and its centered step coordinates are computed from these scores. Only the two generators ran the reference trajectories; the other models only score them. Success rates and action sequences are obtained by running each model itself on different tasks, so the material for the coordinates and the material for the evaluation do not overlap. Scoring uses raw log-likelihoods without the grammar constraint; rescoring with the constraint barely moves the coordinates (Appendix B.1 ).

blocks.en: 3.3 Behavior: do neighbors act alike?
blocks.zh: 3.3行为:邻居的行为是否相同?

blocks.en: In § 3.2 , models that are close in coordinates had similar success rates. Do neighbors also share their behavior when run? Behavior can only be measured as a distance between a pair of models, so the question becomes whether the behavioral distance from a model to its coordinate neighbors is smaller than its distance to the remaining models. We look at neighbors rather than at the correlation over all pairs because the guarantee covers only close pairs (§ 2.4 ). Coordinate neighbors are compared with two kinds of neighbors. The first are neighbors chosen by size, family, or ℓ ¯ \bar{\ell} , which, as in Table 2 , use only information available without running. The second are neighbors chosen by the measured success rate on that benchmark, a reference that is available only after running. Agents with the same success rate do not necessarily solve tasks in the same way, so the gap to the second kind shows what the coordinates capture beyond closeness in performance.
blocks.zh: 在第3.2节中,坐标相近的模型也有类似的成功率。 邻居在逃跑时是否也分享他们的行为? 行为只能作为一对模型之间的距离来测量,所以问题就变成了从一个模型到其坐标相邻的行为距离是否比从它到其余模型的距离要小. 我们审视邻居而不是所有对对的关联性,因为担保只涵盖近对(第2.4节)。 坐标邻被比作两种相邻. 第一个是按大小、家庭或i\bar\ell}选择的邻居,如表2所示,这些邻居只使用可用信息而不运行。 第二个是按该基准衡量的成功率选择的邻国,只有在运行后才能获得这一参考。 具有相同成功率的代理不一定以同样的方式解决任务,因此与第二类的间隙显示在性能上超出近距离的坐标捕获.

blocks.en: We use the action sequences that each model itself produced with the BASE harness: ALFWorld valid_unseen (50 tasks), the environment of the coordinates, and the other environments TextWorld (50), BFCL multi_turn (25), and MiniWoB++ (50), all for the 100 models. The behavioral distance between two models is the distance between their trajectories on the same task, averaged over tasks. Since similar behavior is not a single number, we measure it in four aspects from coarse to fine (definitions in Appendix B.4 ): • Composition (which actions are used how often, ignoring order): Jensen–Shannon distance between the distributions of action types ( Endres and Schindelin, 2003 ) (type JS) • Global (agreement of the whole action sequence): normalized Levenshtein distance ( Levenshtein, 1966 ; Rabanser et al., 2026 ) (edit distance) • Local (what follows a given action): Jaccard distance between the sets of action 2-grams (2-gram) • Early (whether the same first move is made from the same state): disagreement rate of the first action from the same initial state ( Bouchard and Chauhan, 2026 ; Gonuguntla, 2026 ) (first action) The difference in success rate is measured in the same form, which puts the results of § 3.2 on the same scale. The effect size for a model’s five coordinate neighbors is the mean behavioral distance to the remaining models minus the mean distance to the neighbors, divided by the standard deviation over all pairs (positive: neighbors more similar). Figure 1 (c) applies the same definition to the k k -th nearest model alone, in coordinates and in size, averaged over the 100 models and the four aspects.

blocks.en: Section 3 fixed the harness; this section fixes the LLM, varies the harness, and asks what structure the map has with respect to harnesses . A harness combines components for context management, planning, and acting. If adding a component appears as a displacement within an LLM and these displacements add up, the map reads as the position of the LLM plus a sum of component vectors, and the coordinates of an unscored combination follow from the scores of single components. We test whether the approximate additivity observed for prompt changes in LM maps ( Oyama et al., 2026 ) also holds for agent harnesses (§ 4.2 ).

blocks.en: A harness splits the rule C i C_{i} that builds the LLM’s input from the external history h t h_{t} (§ 2.1 ) into three slots. • Context management (which part of the history is shown): windowed passes the initial observation and the last four steps verbatim; retrieve adds past steps retrieved for their relevance; summarize replaces old history with a structured summary. • Planning (whether a plan is rewritten before acting): none / replan. • Acting (whether free-form reasoning is written before the action): direct / think. System instructions, tool definitions, and the initial observation are shared by all harnesses; plans and reasoning enter only the current step’s input, so the external history consists of actions and observations only and every harness builds its input from the same h t h_{t} , both when running and when scoring. The 3 × 2 × 2 = 12 3\times 2\times 2=12 combinations include BASE (windowed/none/direct), four single-component harnesses that add one component to BASE, and seven composed harnesses that add two or more (specifications in Appendix C.1 ).

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: LM maps ( Oyama et al., 2025 ) place models in a common coordinate system by their log-likelihoods on fixed texts and have been extended to prompt–response distributions ( Oyama et al., 2026 ) ; other works embed models by their outputs or correctness ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Yax et al., 2025 ; Zhuang et al., 2025 ) . All of them address static LMs. In reinforcement learning, policies are compared by their actions on a fixed set of states ( Parker-Holder et al., 2020 ; Pacchiano et al., 2020 ; Konyushkova et al., 2021 ) . We extend LM maps to closed-loop agents and quantify the cost of measuring on fixed trajectories as the term λ \lambda , which accumulates over steps like the compounding error of imitation learning ( Ross and Bagnell, 2010 ; Ross et al., 2011 ) . Predicting performance from scores on cheaper benchmarks ( Ruan et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2026 ) shares our goal but needs the target model’s scores, whereas our coordinates need neither scores nor environment runs.
blocks.zh: LM地图(Oyama等,2025年)通过固定文本的对数法将模型放入共同坐标系统,并被扩展至即时响应分布(Oyama等,2026年);其他作品的模型根据其输出或正确性嵌入模型(Wu等,2026年;Yax等,2025年;Zhuang等,2025年). 他们都处理静态LM. 在强化学习方面,政策是通过在固定的一组州采取的行动加以比较的(Parker-Holder等,2020年;Pacchiano等,2020年;Konyushkova等,2021年)。 我们将LM地图扩展至闭路剂,并将固定轨迹测量成本量化为"\\ lambda"一词,该术语在模仿学习的复合错误等步骤上积累(Ross and Bagnell,2010;Ross等人,2011年)。 根据更便宜的基准(Ruan等人, 2024年;Song等人, 2026年)来预测成绩,

blocks.en: Harness effects have been measured as changes in success rate by running every LLM–harness combination ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2026 ; Cho, 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) or decomposed into LLM and scaffold abilities with IRT ( Ge et al., 2026 ) ; we represent a component as a displacement on the map, obtained without running the composed agent, and ask whether displacements add (§ 4 ). Evaluations increasingly report consistency across trials, cost, and behaviors found in logs alongside success rates ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Kapoor et al., 2025 ; Kapoor et al., 2026 ) ; harnesses with similar success rates can differ greatly in token use and failure patterns ( Vats and Golev, 2026 ) , and agent behavior carries fingerprints of the underlying LLM ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Oderinwale, 2026 ; Lugoloobi et al., 2026 ) . All of these works run the agents and compare the resulting behavior through aggregate statistics or classifiers. We measure behavioral differences by distances obtained without running the agents, relate them to the trajectory KL with explicit error bounds (§ 2 ), and show that pairs at small distance behave alike when run (§ 3.3 ).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Agent Behavior Maps, obtained by teacher forcing on common reference trajectories, locate agents without running them. Their coordinates predict the success rates of models that were never run, on the benchmark the map was built from and, combined with size, in other environments. Neighbors on the map take similar action sequences when run. The theory decomposes the gap between the distances and the trajectory KL into four error sources and limits the guarantee to close pairs. Harness components appear as displacements within an LLM whose sums approximate the coordinates of unscored combinations, with an accuracy that depends on the component and the environment. The map represents not only a ranking by performance but also how close agents are in what they do.
blocks.zh: 代理行为 地图,由老师强迫在常见的参考轨迹上获得,不运行就定位特工. 它们的坐标预测了从未运行的模型的成功率,在基准上,地图是从其他环境中建立起来的,加上大小。 地图上的邻居在运行时会采取类似的动作序列. 该理论将相距和轨迹KL之间的相差分解为4个出错源并限制了对对的保证. 合理性元件在LLM中出现,其总和接近无分数组合的坐标,准确性取决于组件和环境。 地图不仅代表了按性能排列的排名,还代表着特工们在所做的事情中有多相近.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Both the theoretical guarantee and the empirical correspondence are limited to close pairs. The KL can be read off the distance only for pairs in the local regime of small ε \varepsilon and λ \lambda , and pairs of different LLMs are not guaranteed to fall in it: the estimates exceed the measured KL by a median factor of 7.5, although their order agrees (§ 3.1 ). The correspondence with behavioral distance holds for neighbors and fades beyond about the 30th neighbor (Figure 1 (c)); we have not shown that the magnitude of the distance between far-apart pairs measures how different their behavior is. The map answers who is similar to whom, not by how much.
blocks.zh: 理论保证和实证对应都仅限于近对. KL只能读取小\\ varepsilon 和\ lambda 的本地制度中的对子的距离, 不同的LLMs 的对子不能保证在其中倒下: 估计值超过测量的 KL 中值为 7.5, 尽管它们的顺序一致(§ 3. 1)。 与行为距离的对应关系为邻居们所持有,并淡出到大约第30个邻居(图1(c));我们没有表明远方对子之间的距离的大小衡量它们的行为是怎样不同的. 地图回答谁和谁相似,不是多少.

In environments where the candidate set can be enumerated, this can be resolved by renormalization, but in general it is a limitation.

blocks.en: The coordinates require the target model’s log-likelihood of a given action sequence. Models that are available only through an API that does not return the log-probabilities of given text cannot be placed on the map, so this study is limited to open-weight models.

blocks.en: The behavioral comparisons are based on one rollout per task, and the behavior of the same model varies from run to run ( Bjarnason et al., 2026 ; Gonuguntla, 2026 ) . We have not compared the size of this variation with the behavioral distance to neighbors.

blocks.en: The harnesses in § 4 are limited to the 12 configurations of our own three-slot design (context management, planning, acting) and to 12 LLMs; the main additivity results are on τ \tau -bench, and ALFWorld and SWE-Bench cover 6 LLMs. Whether the same additivity holds for other scaffolds with differently designed components has not been tested.

blocks.en: B.4.1 Definitions

blocks.en: We use one trajectory per model and task; run conditions are listed in Table 4 . For the 50 ALFWorld valid_unseen tasks, the trajectories come from the same runs as the performance labels. An action sequence is the sequence of commands for the 50 TextWorld treasure-hunter tasks, the sequence of function names extracted from model outputs for the 25 BFCL multi_turn tasks, and the sequence of action strings for the 50 MiniWoB++ tasks. The action type is the leading verb, function name, or tool name. An action is judged invalid by the environment’s set of admissible actions in ALFWorld, by the environment’s feedback that it could not parse the command in TextWorld, by a turn without a function call in BFCL, and by a tool error in MiniWoB++.
blocks.zh: 我们使用每个模型和任务一个轨迹;运行条件见表4。 对于50个ALFWorld 有效_unseen的任务,轨迹来自与性能标签相同的运行. 一个动作序列是50个TextWorld淘宝任务的命令序列,从25个BFCL多_turn任务的模型输出中提取的函数名序列,以及50个MiniWoB++的动作字符串序列 任务。 动作类型是主动词,函数名,或工具名. 根据环境在ALFWorld的一组可受理动作,环境的反馈无法在TextWorld解析指令,在BFCL没有函数调用时转动,以及MiniWoB++中的工具出错,一个动作被判定无效.

blocks.en: The four aspects in the main text are the base-2 Jensen–Shannon distance between action-type frequency distributions ( Endres and Schindelin, 2003 ) , the Levenshtein distance divided by the longer length ( Levenshtein, 1966 ; Rabanser et al., 2026 ) , the Jaccard distance between sets of action 2-grams, and the disagreement rate of the first action from the same initial state ( Bouchard and Chauhan, 2026 ; Gonuguntla, 2026 ) . The first three are computed per task and averaged over the tasks, at least 10, recorded for both models. The appendix tables add four more measures. The divergence position is 1 − k / min ⁡ ( T i , T j ) 1-k/\min(T_{i},T_{j}) , where k k is the number of steps before the first differing action. The conditional disagreement counts disagreement at step t t only for pairs whose action sequences agree up to step t − 1 t-1 , summed over t = 2 , … , 5 t=2,\dots,5 ; only pairs with at least 10 such cases are used. For the first action, conditional disagreement, and divergence position, two invalid actions are not counted as agreeing. The profile distance is the Euclidean distance between per-model vectors standardized within each benchmark; each vector contains task averages of the repetition rate T − | distinct actions | T − 1 \frac{T-|\text{distinct actions}|}{T-1} ( Gioacchini et al., 2024 ) , the consecutive repetition rate, exploration breadth measured as distinct actions / T /T , the invalid-action rate, which is the complement of grounding accuracy ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , the share of information-gathering actions, the format-error rate, steps / / limit, the rate of hitting the step limit, and the early-termination rate. blocks.en: Each model’s five neighbors are the closest models in centered coordinates by Euclidean distance, in size by the difference in log ⁡ | θ | \log|\theta| , in ℓ ¯ \bar{\ell} by the difference in mean log-likelihood on the reference trajectories, in family by taking models of the same family in order of size, and in success rate by the difference in measured success rate on that benchmark. For families with fewer than five other members, the remaining neighbors are taken from other families in order of size. The effect size is the mean behavioral distance to the remaining models minus the mean distance to the five neighbors, averaged over models and divided by the standard deviation of the behavioral distance over all pairs. Figure 1 (c) applies the same definition to the k k -th nearest model alone; ranks k ≤ 5 k\leq 5 are shown individually and larger ranks as bin averages. Significance is assessed by a two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test ( Wilcoxon, 1945 ) paired by model. The comparison between coordinate neighbors and success-rate neighbors, marked † \dagger in the main-text table, uses the same paired test: it asks whether the distance to success-rate neighbors minus the distance to coordinate neighbors, divided by the all-pairs standard deviation, is positive. These are paired tests with models as the unit; pairs share models and no correction for multiple comparisons is applied, so the significance markers are descriptive guides rather than exact error rates. The main conclusions rest on effects that are large (at least 0.5 0.5 for coordinate neighbors in ALFWorld) and consistent across measures rather than on individual markers; small differences marked as significant, such as those between coordinate and success-rate neighbors in the other environments, should be read as suggestive.

blocks.en: Instead of comparing with neighbors chosen by success rate, part B of Table 8 removes the effect of performance by regression. We regress each behavioral distance on the difference in success rate, the pair’s mean success rate and its square, and the difference in log ⁡ | θ | \log|\theta| , and compute the effect of coordinate neighbors on the residuals. We control for the mean success rate as well because strong models converge on the shortest solutions and therefore act alike. For the success pattern, we instead subtract its expectation under a null distribution generated by the curveball algorithm ( Strona et al., 2014 ) , which shuffles outcomes while keeping each model’s success rate and each task’s difficulty fixed. After this control, the effect of coordinate neighbors remains on every aspect in ALFWorld, the environment of the coordinates, and mainly on the local and early-step measures in the other environments.
blocks.zh: 表8B部分没有与成功率选择的邻居进行比较,而是通过回归来去除性能的效果. 在成功率、对等成功率及其平方和对数的相差上, 我们控制着平均的成功率,因为强有力的模式集中到最短的解决办法上,因此,我们同样采取行动。 对于成功模式,我们却在曲线球算法(Strona 等,2014年)产生的无效分布下减去了它的预期值。 曲线球算法在保持每个模型的成功率和每个任务难度的同时,对结果进行扭曲。 在这一控制之后,相邻协调对ALFWorld的每一个方面,即坐标的环境,以及主要对其他环境中的局部和早期措施的影响仍然存在.

blocks.en: The input is assembled in the order fixed part, history selected by context management, plan and reasoning for the current step, and action instruction. The fixed part consists of the system instructions, tool definitions, and initial observation (including the task instruction) and is shared by all harnesses. One block of the external history is an executed action and the resulting observation; past plans and reasoning are not included. The budget for the history part is 8,192 tokens, and the whole input is at most 16,384 tokens including the reserve for the output; when the budget is exceeded, the oldest blocks are dropped first and, if necessary, the latest observation is truncated to its head and tail.

blocks.en: • Context management : windowed passes the initial observation and the last four blocks verbatim. retrieve additionally selects, from the older history, blocks relevant to the current observation by BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) (weight 0.7) and recency (0.3) and inserts up to 1,536 tokens of them. summarize splits the older history, summarizes the parts, and merges them hierarchically into a JSON memory of at most 1,024 tokens that replaces the history. If the history has at most four blocks and uses at most 75% of the budget, neither retrieval nor summarization is applied and the history is passed raw. • Planning : replan rewrites from scratch, at every step and in at most 256 tokens, the confirmed progress, the next subgoal, and the observation that would confirm its achievement, and adds them to the input of the current step. • Acting : think generates, for the next single action, step-by-step reasoning of at most 512 tokens that organizes the goal, constraints, assumptions, and expected effect of the action, and adds it to the input of the current step (the plan, if any, is also included in the input). Plans and reasoning are not carried over to the next step.
